name: Forced displacement
summary: No new event displacing 500,000; 8.6 million remain displaced inside Sudan
state: No single new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month had been found as of 6 Nov. UNHCR and IOM said on 6 Nov that about 8.6 million people are displaced inside Sudan and 4.6 million have fled abroad, and warned the internal figure could rise again (Reuters via TimesLIVE; UNHCR). That is a long-running crisis rather than a new event.
for_you: Mainly affects people in conflict zones and neighbouring host countries. Large new movements usually follow sharp escalations in fighting.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event displacing more than 500,000 in a month
